summary: Added git-based merged-branch fallback to /costflow in routes/analytics.js. Before the nodes map, runs `git branch --merged HEAD` once in the workspace (try/catch — silently skips non-git workspaces). In the map, if a task has a git branch that appears in the merged set but the overlay flag is not set, marks merged=true and calls overlayStore.setGit to backfill the overlay. After the map, saves + notifies if any backfill occurred. Also added `execFileSync` require at top of file. Syntax verified clean.

subject: Fix 3: Backfill merged signal from git at costflow time
description: In routes/analytics.js, during /costflow computation, for any task with t.git.branch but t.git.merged=false, check `git branch --merged <base>` to detect branches merged outside the daemon. If merged, treat as merged:true in the flow AND write the signal back to the overlay (setGit merged:true, merge_sha, merged_at) so future reads are correct. Independent of fixes 1 and 2.
